# Craft

Generated from [tokens.json](tokens.json) and [README.md](README.md) by the design-systems catalog tool. Do not edit this file: change the tokens through the package's builders, then run `make design-md` at the repository root.

It follows the DESIGN.md spec, version alpha. That format has no themes, no per-value provenance and only px, em and rem units, so this file holds the `light` theme alone with every alias resolved. [tokens.json](tokens.json) is the source of truth: it records where each value was read, and keeps the 7 tokens from these groups that DESIGN.md cannot hold (gradients, shadows, percentages, durations and other non-colour or non-px values).

## Overview

Good for: Docs/notes marketing surfaces: Untitled Serif 400 display (54-70px page titles, 66px hero, 48px mobile) over a #fcf9f7 warm beige with #030302 ink everywhere, a shadcn-style semantic layer (--background/--card/--primary/--accent teal/--border hairlines), a floating 52px white nav pill, rounded-full pills on every CTA and the Yearly/Monthly billing toggle, a 3px 6%-ink focus ring, the black CTA's 75%-ink hover lift, and a 24px-radius black footer panel.

Captured 2026-11-12, signed out (every captured surface is public; there is no auth card on www.craft.do - Log in links out to docs.craft.do and was never followed; Try Craft Free and the platform buttons lead to /download and were never used; the billing toggle was flipped locally and flipped back, nothing purchased). Served the Singapore region: prices render SGD.. Themes: light.

Craft's public signed-out surface — the home page, pricing, download, imagine, learn, write and the blog index — captured 2026-11-12 in headless Chromium at 1440 x 900, plus the home and pricing pages at 390 x 844. The editors live in the apps and were never reached; www.craft.do has no auth card.

## Do's and Don'ts

- Do take values from [tokens.json](tokens.json) when you need another theme, a value's source, or a token this file leaves out.
- Do read [README.md](README.md) before relying on a value; it says what is known to be wrong.
- Don't read colours off the screenshots; they are 256-colour PNGs.
- Don't copy the product's logo, icons, illustrations or brand colours into something that ships. Borrow structure and proportions.
- Don't edit this file; it is regenerated from the tokens.
